articles.title: New York-based Bango to open first Pennsylvania location in Lehigh Valley
articles.summary: Bango, a New York-based healthy eatery known for fresh bowls and smoothies, plans to open its first Pennsylvania location near Allentown in Lehigh Valley.

articles.title: Chicken Salad Chick opening first Pennsylvania location in Allentown
articles.summary: Chicken Salad Chick expands to Pennsylvania with a new restaurant in Allentown's Airport Center Shopping Center, opening Aug. 4.

articles.title: SACA completes renovations on Lancaster affordable housing project
articles.summary: SACA Development Corporation completed renovations at The Apartments at General Cigar Place, preserving 30 affordable housing units in Lancaster. The post SACA completes renovations on Lancaster affordable housing project appeared first on Central Penn Business Journal .

articles.title: Linlo Properties, Keller Contracting break ground on Cumberland County state health center
articles.summary: Linlo Properties and Keller Contracting begin renovation and expansion of a state health center in Cumberland County. The post Linlo Properties, Keller Contracting break ground on Cumberland County state health center appeared first on Central Penn Business Journal .
